user.title: Connect an AUDAC NWP220
user.description: Enter the panel hostname or IPv4 address. Uses native UDP port 8711. Enable advanced options to change the port.

reconfigure.title: Change connection settings
reconfigure.description: Use this when the same panel changes IP address. Existing device and entity identities are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the NWP220. Check the host, UDP port, network access and firmware support for grouped commands.

init.title: Polling
init.description: One poll reads all core controls using five grouped requests.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send one ASCII request to the selected panel and read back state. Addresses are replaced by the integration.

command.name: Command
command.description: One complete GET_REQ or SET_REQ frame; line termination is optional.
